summary: Lifezone Metals filed a Form 6-K announcing an US$8 million reduction in the cap on consideration payable to BHP Billiton (UK) DDS Limited, tied to its July 2025 definitive agreement to acquire BHP's 17% equity interest in Kabanga Nickel Limited. An independent expert, Ed O'Keefe of Synergy Global Consulting, confirmed during August-September 2026 that the Kabanga Resettlement Action Plan remains materially aligned with IFC Performance Standard 5, triggering the automatic reduction. Remaining consideration comprises a US$10 million fixed deferred cash payment and a contingent payment based on a US$28 million reference amount indexed to Lifezone's share price.
